scheduling.title: Scheduling
scheduling.description: Configure opening-hour segments and block specific dates
scheduling.missingBlockedDatesTable: Missing database table. Please run the SQL migration for 'blocked_dates' in your Supabase dashboard.
scheduling.homepageInfoBarDescription: Control the address and reservation number shown beneath the homepage hero. Hours are generated automatically from the opening-hour segments below.
scheduling.hoursPreviewHint: Auto-generated from opening hours below. Save those hours to publish changes.
scheduling.openingHoursDescription: Set one or more service segments per day — for example morning 09:00–11:00, lunch 12:00–14:00, dinner 18:00–22:00. Guests can only book inside these windows. Changes are batched — click “Save Changes” to persist.
scheduling.blockedDatesDescription: Click a date to toggle it as blocked. Blocked dates are highlighted in red and instantly persisted — no save step required.

floor.title: Floor Plan
floor.description: Live dining room — room layout, expected turn time, temporary merges, and auto-assign
floor.mergeNeedsTwo: Select at least two tables to merge.
floor.onlyAvailableTables: Only available tables can be merged.
floor.editModeHint: Edit mode is on. Unlock a table (padlock) to drag it. Drop an available table onto another to merge. Drag a merged table onto an empty cell to split. Locked tables stay put.
floor.serviceModeHint: Service mode is on. Select tables to manage the dining room; positions are protected.
floor.dragSplitOrMerge: Drag onto an empty cell to split, or onto another table to merge
floor.dragToMerge: Drag to a new cell, or onto another available table to merge
floor.unlockPadlock: Unlock the padlock to rearrange this table
floor.autoAssignHint: Tables are auto-assigned at booked time minus expected turn (default 90).
floor.noReservation: No reservation on this table right now.
floor.cellHint: Cell {x}, {y}. Unlock, then drag on the floor plan.
floor.statusUpdatesMerge: Status updates every table in {label}. Available and Out of service split the arrangement.
floor.expectedTurnHint: Max / expected turn time. Merges last this long by default.
floor.unlockMemberHint: Unlock a member and drag it onto an empty cell to split, or drop another available table here to add it.
floor.unlockThenDrag: Unlock this table, then drag it onto another available table to merge. The picker below is a fallback.
floor.noMergePartners: No other available tables to merge right now.
floor.onlyAvailableMerge: Only available tables without a reservation can be merged. Unlock one and drop it onto another on the floor.
floor.selectTablePrompt: Select a table to edit its status, expected time, and capacity.
floor.chooseTable: Choose a table on the floor plan.

branding.title: Branding
branding.logoDescription: Upload a logo for {name} on the guest header, staff login, and console. PNG, JPG, SVG, or WEBP, up to 2MB. The platform ships with no default mark — removing a logo leaves the name only.
branding.heroDescription: Upload a background photo for the homepage hero. PNG, JPG, or WEBP, up to 4MB. The platform ships with no default photo — until one is uploaded, the hero renders a blank background.
